note: Discovery only. Every Vial is an author-hosted project. There is no official tier. Osmograph fetches the manifest from its raw URL, runs the same local policy gate as a file import, and runs any sandboxed UI beside it. A listing is not a security review, a safety certification, or an endorsement.

vials.name: Coffee Roast Log
vials.author: @example-author
vials.tagline: Track the roast, not just the aroma.
vials.summary: A reference manifest for testing URL install and the local policy gate. It is a template for authors, not a validated roasting controller or a real product.
vials.install: Paste the manifest URL into Osmograph → Vials → Aromatory → Install from URL.

vials.name: Fermentation Lab
vials.author: @praisejamesx
vials.tagline: The batch is the record; the array is one change detector inside it.
vials.summary: Home-fermentation workspace: batch protocol, readings log, stop rules, and a sandboxed Home view. Declares host-enforced ΔR/R₀ transforms, a single-unit watch limit derived from measured channel noise, and a persisted trajectory. It is not a food-safety instrument; the stop rules point at the primary measurement.
vials.install: Install from source above, or paste the manifest URL in Osmograph → Vials → Aromatory.

vials.name: Plant Respiration
vials.author: @praisejamesx
vials.tagline: The plant is the evidence; the array is one change detector.
vials.summary: Plant-health workspace: weekly readings with leaf, soil, water, and action context, plus a measurement-first Home. Declares host-enforced ΔR/R₀ transforms, a single-unit watch limit derived from measured channel noise, and a persisted trajectory. It does not detect ethylene, pests, or pathogens.
vials.install: Install from source above, or paste the manifest URL in Osmograph → Vials → Aromatory.
